errorAlreadyAssigned: That 3D model is already assigned to "{title}". Each model can only be used on one product — remove it from that product first, or upload a separate copy of the file.
errorProductLimit: You've reached your {plan} plan limit of {limit} products with a 3D model. Upgrade your plan to add more.
errorModelLimit: You've reached your {plan} plan limit of {limit} 3D models. Upgrade your plan to add more.
errorUploadFailed: Failed to upload file to Shopify
errorNoFileId: Shopify did not return a file id
notFoundBody: The requested product could not be loaded.
confirmRemoveBody: The product stops showing a 3D model on your storefront. The .glb file itself stays in Shopify Files and can be reassigned later.
confirmResetBody: Every viewer setting for this product goes back to its default. The assigned model file is untouched.
optimizeDetails: Shrinks the file so shoppers see the model sooner. Turn off to keep the file exactly as it is.
chooseFromFilesA11y: Choose a 3D model from Shopify Files
viewerSettingsHelp: Saved to custom.viewer_3d_config. The storefront viewer uses these instead of the theme block defaults.
embedHelp: For themes that can't add app blocks. Paste this code where the configurator should appear: your theme's product template, a page, or a Custom Liquid section. It shows the full Product configurator: gallery, variants, customer options and add to cart.
embedTemplateHelp: Uses the handle of the product being viewed, so one paste in the product template covers every product.
embedMaxWidthDetails: Centred, and never wider than this.
embedAfterAddUpdate: Stay and update the cart count
